question: From the following, name the region located in the western coast.
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Malabar Region**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Malabar Region** is located on the western coast of India.
 
• This region is known for its unique geographical features, including a long coastline along the Arabian Sea.
 
• The Malabar Region includes parts of the Indian states of Kerala and Karnataka.
 
• This region is historically significant, having been a major center for spice trade and cultural exchange.
 
• The lush greenery and backwaters of the Malabar Coast make it a popular tourist destination.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Coromandel Coast** is located on the southeastern coast of India.
 
• **The Assam Region** is situated in the northeastern part of India, known for its tea gardens and biodiversity.
 
• **The Indus Plain Region** refers to the area around the Indus River, primarily located in Pakistan.
 
• The Malabar Region has been a melting pot of various cultures, including Hindu, Muslim, and Christian communities.
 
• The region is also known for its traditional art forms, such as Kathakali and Theyyam.
